_comment: The one copy of the c7shell palette and of the appearance defaults (spec §4, §7).
Six things used to hold their own literals and drift apart: Theme/Theme.qml,
hypr/conf/appearance.lua, hypr/conf/look-and-feel.lua and the login greeter's
own Theme.qml. They had already drifted -- appearance.lua called itself the
mirror of the JsonAdapter and was missing inactiveBorder, which
look-and-feel.lua consumes -- so all six now read this file instead.
tests/test-qml-hygiene.sh fails the build on a colour literal outside it.
`palette` is what the design is. `defaults` is what a missing or corrupt
~/.config/hypr/appearance.json falls back to -- they are NOT settings: the
settings app writes that file, and it wins over everything here.
The variants Theme can render. `bg` is the deepest layer (item views),
`canvas` the window behind them, `glassBase` the popover base -- used with
glassAlpha per surface. A variant may override any top-level ink.
palette._overlay: What Theme's surfaceNN, hairlines and hover pills are a translucent layer OF: white lifts a dark ground, black sinks a light one.
palette._textOnAccent: Ink ON an accent or otherwise selected surface. Pure white, not `text`: #f0eff1 on crimson reads grey, which is why five files had this literal.
palette._warning: The "needs attention, but nothing is broken" amber: a pacnew waiting to be reviewed, tuned not running, and the greeter's battery pill.
palette._negative: The exporter's KDE colour groups only. The shell has no failure colour of its own yet -- it says wrong with the accent.
palette._greeterBg: The login greeter's ground. Deeper than the shell's `dark` bg on purpose: there is no compositor behind the greeter to blur with, so the fill carries the whole glass effect.
_accentChoices: The four alternates from the mock, oklch(0.62 0.19 h) for h in {25,300,230,150},
converted once here rather than at every repaint. 230 and 150 fall outside sRGB
at that chroma and are gamut-mapped the way CSS Color 4 does it, so the swatches
match the mockup rendered in a browser.
palette._borderChoices: Inactive borders are the quiet half of the pair: neutrals, plus the accent itself for anyone who wants both borders tinted.

_comment: The mirror that used to be maintained by hand in three languages. Every key
here is a property of Services/AppearanceStore.qml's JsonAdapter, and the
adapter's shape is the contract: add a key there and add it here.
